result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL is USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O is USD 2M, cyber is USD 5M for IBM as a stated processor of Customer Data, workers’ compensation is required by law, and certificates are available on request. The original risk-of-loss allocation remains unchanged. However, requiring all coverages to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is particularly awkward for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation, so the revision is not strictly minimal.
